theme.title: Swat team
theme.subtitle: Blocked-shot records
theme.recap: Blocks were first counted in 1973–74, and the records include Elmore Smith's 11 in a half and Dwight Howard's nine in a Finals game.

questions.prompt: Dwight Howard set the Finals record for blocks in a game in 2009. How many?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: giving him a single-game NBA Finals record with 9 blocked shots

questions.prompt: In the first season blocks were counted, Elmore Smith set the record for blocks in a half. How many?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 11 blocks in a half, setting the NBA record. 6 blocks in one quarter; 5 blocks in the other quarter

questions.prompt: Manute Bol set the record for blocks in a quarter in December 1985. How many?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 8 blocks in the first quarter, setting the NBA record, and 11 blocks in the first half, tying the NBA record

questions.prompt: In March 2001, Toronto set what was then the NBA record for team blocks in a game. How many?
questions.note: 23, an NBA record at the time.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Raptors combined for 23 blocks, an NBA record at the time

questions.prompt: David Robinson's 1994 quadruple-double included 10 blocks. How many points did he score?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: with 34 points, 10 rebounds, 10 assists, and 10 blocks against the Detroit Pistons on February 17, 1994
